summary: DARK ORBIT – AI Powered SphereX Sky Explorer is an innovative space exploration project designed to make understanding the universe easier and more engaging. It aims to use Artificial Intelligence and interactive technology to help users explore the sky, discover celestial objects, and learn more about space. The project focuses on making complex space-related information easier to understand through an accessible and user-friendly experience. By combining AI-powered features with space exploration concepts, DARK ORBIT aims to encourage curiosity, improve space awareness, and inspire people to learn more about the mysteries of our universe.
details:
PLANET X is an AI-powered SPHEREx Sky Explorer and Gravity Simulator designed to help users explore astronomical observations, identify moving celestial objects, understand planetary motion, and track satellites through an interactive web platform.

The project consists of four major modules:

1. SPHEREx Sky Explorer: Allows users to explore different regions of the sky and view infrared astronomical observations across different bands.

2. Moving Object Detection: Analyses astronomical images from different observations to identify objects that change their positions, helping highlight potential asteroids, comets, and other moving celestial objects.

3. Planet X Gravity Simulator: Provides an interactive simulation to understand gravitational forces and the motion of celestial bodies.

4. Satellite Tracker: Helps users explore satellite tracking information and understand satellite movement.

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, API integration, and AI-based image analysis concepts.

Impact: The project aims to make astronomical data more accessible and understandable through interactive visualization and simulation. It combines space science, artificial intelligence, and web technologies into a single educational platform.

Creativity: Integrating astronomical image exploration, moving object detection, gravity simulation, and satellite tracking into one platform makes the project an interactive space exploration tool.
